title: Incremental Aquarium clicker game
author: boroscode
selftext:
Hey guys i just released my first demo, i would love to hear your thoughts about this. 
Link: https://morningdust.itch.io/midnight-aquarium-idle-clicker

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body:
I thought it's not loading haha then I scroll down and see the "Run" Button. Great game! Have you thought about uploading it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) ? You could get instant feedback from the community, earn XP, and maybe even showcase your game to more players. Definitely worth a try!

https://preview.redd.it/ergfyb494z4g1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=ba5577eb2db1305700d75caced2f4dbfec8b61f4

replies.author: boroscode
replies.body: Hahah thanks, i will definitely check it out!

replies.author: boroscode
replies.body: Glad you like it! In a couple of days i am planning on releasing early access on steam
